EEG REPORT (continuous video EEG)
Recording: 2031-07-26 13:40 to 16:00.
Indication: ICE decline after CAR-T; r/o nonconvulsive sz.
Background: diffuse theta slowing, 5-6 Hz, reactive.
Events: 3 discrete electrographic seizures arising from the L temporal region, onset 13:55, 14:08 and 14:27, each 40-90 s, w/o clinical correlate. Between seizures the background returned to its baseline (reactive theta). LEV 1 g IV given 14:20. Last electrographic seizure ended 14:28; none thereafter through end of recording.
Impression:
1. Nonconvulsive electrographic seizures, L temporal, each <2 min with return to baseline background between them; resolved after IV levetiracetam.
2. Diffuse slowing.
